verses.verse:
रागांगस्तु समे स्थाप्यो विरामस्तत्र शोभते।
राग वाचिक्रमेणैव ततः संवादिनं ब्रजेत।१३६।
verses.text: The rāga's main part should be placed on the sam, and a pause there is graceful; then, following the order of the rāga's identifying notes, one should move to the saṃvādī.

commentary.text: That is, for any rāga whose gat (instrumental composition) is to be made, write its note against the first mātrā (beat) of the chosen tāla, and put a pause mark (–) of at least one mātrā on the second mātrā. After that, keeping in mind the movement of that rāga, move towards the saṃvādī (consonant second note) as an apanyāsa (intermediate resting note), and whatever notes you think proper to use in it, count them and write them under the remaining mātrās. Then, moving on from there, make a nyāsa (resting note) on Sa with a pause of at least one mātrā. Write the notes of that nyāsa, in turn, under the remaining mātrās. Now, if the mātrās of the tāla have not all been filled, count those remaining mātrās and devise a group of notes of that many mātrās which can make a nyāsa on the vādī (principal note) placed earlier. Now, when playing it, do not begin from the first mātrā but from that very group of notes devised as the nyāsa of the vādī note. Just as, when making a bansī, the order of marking the svarasthānas (note positions) is one thing and the order of making holes at those marks is another, in the same way the order of notes when composing a gat differs from the order of notes when playing it. For example, if Rāga Bhūpālī is to be set in Rūpak tāla, then after writing the number of mātrās of the tāla, with its division of mātrās, properly in the form of a grid, the notes of Bhūpālī will be entered against those very signs by the method given above. In the grid below, the numbers at the top are in the order of the tāla, and the composing has also been done in that order. That note will not be played at the beginning when playing. But sometimes, as an exception, the order of composing and the order of playing remain the same.
